NOTICE.TITLE: Regulation (EU) 2023/956 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 10 May 2023 on transaction monitoring obligations for payment service providers — AMENDED VERSION (Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/2156)
NOTICE.CONTENTS:
Article 1 - Subject matter. This Regulation lays down obligations for payment service providers regarding the monitoring of payment transactions to detect and prevent money laundering, terrorist financing, and fraud.
Article 2 - Transaction monitoring thresholds. 1. Payment service providers shall monitor all payment transactions. 2. Transactions exceeding EUR 5,000 in a single operation shall be subject to enhanced monitoring procedures as described in Article 4. [AMENDED — threshold reduced from EUR 10,000] 3. Aggregate transactions from the same customer exceeding EUR 15,000 in a calendar month shall trigger a mandatory review. [AMENDED — threshold reduced from EUR 25,000] 4. Payment service providers operating cross-border services shall apply a threshold of EUR 3,000 for transactions involving high-risk third countries. [NEW PARAGRAPH]
Article 3 - Monitoring systems. 1. Payment service providers shall maintain automated monitoring systems capable of detecting: (a) structuring patterns indicative of smurfing; (b) rapid movement of funds through multiple accounts; (c) transactions inconsistent with the customer's established profile; (d) mule account activity patterns as specified in EBA/GL/2024/12. [NEW POINT (d)] 2. Monitoring rules and thresholds shall be reviewed semi-annually and updated where necessary. [AMENDED — from annually to semi-annually]
Article 4 - Enhanced monitoring procedures. For transactions subject to enhanced monitoring under Article 2, payment service providers shall conduct a manual review within 24 hours and file a SAR if suspicion is confirmed. [AMENDED — time limit reduced from 48 to 24 hours]
Article 5 - Record retention. Transaction monitoring records shall be retained for seven years. [AMENDED — from five to seven years]
Article 6 - Entry into force. This Regulation enters into force on 1 November 2023. The amendments introduced by Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/2156 apply from 1 October 2024.
